## v419 - Recovery Center compact UI

- 복구 센터 기본 화면을 요약/캐시/검색/정책 중심으로 축소했습니다.
- 수동 진단, 원본 진단, 대형 목록 진단, 체크리스트는 고급 진단 접힘 영역으로 이동했습니다.
- 상태 카드도 핵심 4개만 우선 노출하고 체크포인트/고아 데이터는 상세 상태로 접었습니다.
- 기능 삭제 없이 DOM id와 기존 버튼 wiring은 유지했습니다.
- 검증 marker: `v419-recovery-center-compact-ui-smoke-pass`, `v419-recovery-center-advanced-collapse-pass`, `v419-recovery-summary-compact-pass`.

## v526 - Owner diagnostics Cloudflare Tunnel HTTPS alignment

- `/api/admin/diagnostics` now mirrors the v525 login HTTPS gate: in `DEPLOYMENT_MODE=cloudflare-tunnel`, `CF-Visitor: {"scheme":"https"}` is trusted as the effective HTTPS signal even when NPM forwards `X-Forwarded-Proto=http`.
- Owner 운영 상태 cards now show effective protocol, raw `X-Forwarded-Proto`, and `CF-Visitor` trust state separately.
- The old false `forwarded_proto_mismatch` error is replaced by an ok `forwarded_proto_cf_visitor` finding when Cloudflare visitor HTTPS is trusted.
- Smoke: `tools/checks/admin-cloudflare-visitor-diagnostics-smoke.js`.

## v528 - Cloudflare Tunnel exposure diagnostics

- Owner 운영 상태에 `v528-cloudflare-tunnel-exposure-diagnostics-pass`를 추가했다.
- `DEPLOYMENT_MODE=cloudflare-tunnel`에서 현재 요청의 `CF-Visitor`, `CF-Connecting-IP`, `CF-Ray`, `CDN-Loop` 등 Cloudflare 계열 header를 표시한다.
- 서버 단독으로 WAN 직접 노출 여부를 확정하지 않는다는 점을 `unknown-server-side`로 명시하고, 운영자가 확인해야 하는 WAN 차단 항목을 owner 페이지 checklist로 표시한다.
- 새 smoke: `tools/checks/admin-cloudflare-tunnel-exposure-diagnostics-smoke.js` (`v528-cloudflare-tunnel-exposure-diagnostics-smoke-pass`).

## v530 - security hardening bundle

- `package-lock.json` is now included in the release archive so production installs are reproducible.
- Docker Compose examples now use the project `Dockerfile`/`npm ci` build path instead of runtime `npm install`.
- Compose examples add non-root image execution, read-only root filesystem, `/tmp` tmpfs, `cap_drop: ALL`, and `no-new-privileges`.
- Session and CSRF token persistence now stores HMAC digests instead of plaintext tokens. Existing plaintext sessions are ignored and users must sign in again.
- Login rate limiting now keys by client IP plus normalized login identity.
- Login page no longer writes CSRF tokens to `localStorage`.
- `MAX_TEXT_FILE_BYTES` limits single TXT processing before synchronous file reads; content and block-manifest APIs return 413 when exceeded.
- Docs and smoke tests updated for the v530 security model.

## v533 - package-lock public registry + LXC AppArmor deployment note

- Regenerated the distributed package lock as a regular file whose `resolved` tarball URLs point at `https://registry.npmjs.org/` instead of the sandbox/internal npm gateway.
- Added `.npmrc` to pin the public npm registry for external Docker builds and `npm ci` deployments.
- Added smoke coverage for regular-file lockfile, public registry lockfile URLs, and no internal npm gateway references.
- Documented that `runc ... unable to apply apparmor profile` during Docker build is a Proxmox/LXC nested-Docker AppArmor problem, not an npm or package-lock failure. Prefer Docker in a VM/host; if using LXC, fix the LXC/AppArmor/nesting configuration before building.
# v534 - search coverage preview scheduling

- Baseline ZIP: `txt_reader_multi_v533`; output ZIP: `txt_reader_multi_v534.zip`; runtime marker: `rebuild-v534`.
- Search modal open and post-search completion no longer wait on the coverage preview scan. The preview is now scheduled with a short delay, canceled on close/cleanup, and coalesced while a preview scan is already active.
- Search worker cachebuster moved to `rebuild-v534` so browsers pick up the current worker script with the runtime.
- Smoke: `tools/checks/search-coverage-preview-schedule-smoke.js` (`v534-search-coverage-preview-schedule-smoke-pass`).

## v557 - Expanded multilingual TXT encoding detection

- 서버 TXT 디코더를 UTF-8/EUC-KR 중심에서 다국어 자동 판별 구조로 확장했습니다.
- 추가 감지 흐름: BOM 기반 UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32 → UTF-8 유효성 우선 → jschardet 기반 감지 → 후보 인코딩 점수화 fallback.
- 기본 후보에 CP949/EUC-KR, Shift_JIS/CP932/EUC-JP, GB18030/GBK/GB2312, Big5, Windows-1251/1252 계열, Arabic/Hebrew/Thai/Vietnamese 계열을 포함했습니다.
- `.env.example`에 `TEXT_FILE_ENCODING`, `TEXT_FILE_ENCODING_CANDIDATES`, `TEXT_FILE_CHARDET_MIN_CONFIDENCE`를 추가했습니다.
- content worker와 main content service가 같은 디코더를 사용하도록 중복 로직을 통합했습니다.
- Smoke: `tools/checks/server-text-encoding-autodetect-smoke.js` (`v557-expanded-text-decoder-smoke-pass`).
